name: Pong
tagline: Pong across two phones. Send the link, first to nine.
description:
Send a friend the invite. They take the other paddle on their phone or their computer.

On your own you play a computer that gets sharper when it is behind and sloppier when it is winning. Drag your paddle with a finger, or use Q and A on the left and P and L on the right. First to nine. Close it, come back: your wins are remembered.

An unofficial port of Jake Gordon's JavaScript Pong. This copy adds a friend on a second device, and a paddle you can drag.
